content.comment_body: I recently purchased the [product_name] starter kit [product_name] TDE 12/24V 1P [article_no], which includes two DVDs with [product_name] Soft Comfort [version_no], [product_name] STEP 7 Basic/Professional, [product_name] WinCC Basic/Comfort/Advanced [version_no], and a USB license key for [product_name] WinCC Basic [version_no]. There's no separate license for [product_name] Soft Comfort [version_no], so is it free? My issue is that my PC has no CD/DVD drive. While I can download some software online, I can't access the [product_name] software, which seems to be license-free. How can I install it?

The included [product_name] Soft Comfort is a full version and does not require extra licensing. Without the starter kit, you'd need to purchase it. Can you use an external DVD drive, or have someone copy the DVD to a USB stick? Note that downloading the [product_name] software from the [company_name] website only gives you an upgrade/update, not a full install—so you'll still need the full version first.

I plan to power up an old laptop to copy the disc to a USB flash drive to get what I paid for. Other than that, the only alternative seems to be downloading the software from potentially unsafe websites.
Having no DVD-ROM drive might be economical, but internal or external drives are useful for installing various software packages. In Germany, drives can be found for less than 10 EUR.

It's surprising that in 2021, the starter kit still comes with the software on a DVD! Searching online, most threads recommend using another machine to copy the files to a USB stick. A better approach would be to provide the software directly on a USB stick instead of a DVD, especially since most computers lack optical drives nowadays. If a USB key is used for licensing, just include all installation files on the same stick and skip DVDs entirely. Downloading could be another option, but USB is preferable for offline use. Now I need to find a DVD drive that can connect to my laptop to proceed.
Exactly. You might as well supply it on a floppy disk! Expecting customers to use outdated storage media for accessing installation files is hard to understand.
So there is no way to install the software without a DVD? Is there no downloadable setup file? I've tried to get it online, but my account verification has been pending for weeks.
You could copy the DVD image to a USB stick or buy a USB DVD drive.

Hi [user_name], I forwarded your feedback to the relevant team and confirmation was received that your download authorization was granted on 8/1/2022, and you accessed the software on that date. After two years, you'll receive an email asking if you'd like to renew your authorization. If not confirmed, the process will need to be repeated.

I'm in the same position and it's confusing. I have the original DVD and want to migrate from an older laptop to a new machine that has no optical drive. Downloaded upgrade asks for the installed software, which I don't have. The basic software doesn’t need a license but is only available on DVD. It's only usable for [product_name]. Everyone who purchased [product_name] needs this software, while those who didn’t get it have no use for it. Why require the original software installed for upgrades instead of allowing direct download of the full install package? This doesn't make sense for users without the DVD.
The installation CD or DVD itself acts as the license.

This is frustrating. My [product_name] just arrived with DVDs, and I've wasted over an hour trying workarounds for the installation. The initial experience isn't as user-friendly as expected, but hopefully, that improves once the software is installed.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are dissatisfied with the way [product_name] Soft Comfort is distributed—only on DVD—making installation complicated due to the lack of optical drives in modern PCs. While the software doesn’t require a license, obtaining a full version without the DVD is difficult; only upgrades are available online. They view options like using external drives or copying files as inconvenient workarounds, wishing for more modern and accessible solutions.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect access to the full version of [product_name] Soft Comfort via convenient and current methods, such as a USB stick or direct online download, suitable for PCs without optical drives.
